text.en:
llth. MARCH, 2019 No. S 5

TOWN PLANNERS REGISTRATION ORDER, 2014 (S 4012014) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section l(1) of the Town Planners Registration Order, 2014, the Minister of Development, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st January 2019 as the date on which that Order shall be deemed to have commenced. Dated this 4th. day of Rejab, 1440 Hijriah corresponding to the llth. day of March, 2019.

DATO SERI SETIA AWANG HAJI SUHAIMI BIN HAJI GAFAR Minister of Development, Brunei Darussalam.
